claim: Recognising the native validate_shards.py run command restores discovery protection independently of other workflow runners or test-directory mentions.

sources.mechanism: The run subcommand discovers from the working directory with pattern test*.py and the same top-level directory.
Native discovery loads matching modules at the root and traverses importable packages.

fail_before.fixture: Real repository tree and real shard suite step, with other workflows removed and a new tests/test_brand_new_module.py injected.
fail_before.pr957_replay: Compile the exact push_gate.py source from pr957_head in a fresh gate module; run the same TestCase with GitTree at pr957_head. Resolver dependencies match main at this head.

git_free_regression.boundary: MemoryTree derivation with subprocess.run raising on any attempted process launch

monitoring_correction.reason: The existing derivation contract excludes discovered test modules from gate-script import tracing. test_catalogs.py is now correctly classified ci_discovered.

limitations: The new-module and command-variant regressions use synthetic fixtures executed by the installed unittest client; the full tree comparisons are local integration measurements.
CPython v3.12.3 is the requested mechanism pin; execution used the installed Python 3.13.16 client.
No production resolver, broker, model or live provider was exercised.
Coverage follows the existing package-discovery policy; this does not claim arbitrary non-package directories are discovered.
